positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
In charge of client accounts and maintaining a relationship with existent clients.  Seek new project opportunities within the existent accounts in order to establish a long-lasting relationship.

Responsible of invoicing, statement of works and change orders for assigned accounts.

Serve as technical sales support when needed.
